title: Existing inheritance already works
evidence: LabelComponent extends TextComponent, OperativeTile/SquadSlot extend TileComponent, and specialized rows extend ListRow. Preserve these useful contracts instead of introducing a universal widget superclass.
resolution: Retained; SurfaceView adds common painting without replacing native control bases.

title: Card selection and surface behavior were isolated
evidence: CardComponent supplied slots and selection while PerkCard and specialized surfaces reimplemented the same frame and selected state.
resolution: CardView centralizes selection and SurfaceView centralizes painting; CardComponent retains optional slots and PerkCard uses CardView without extra layout wrappers.

title: Detail and holographic surfaces duplicated construction
evidence: OperativeDetails, OperativeStats, PerkDetail and HoloFrame independently initialized shape and picking behavior.
resolution: DetailView and SurfaceView now supply shared behavior; SkillSummary and FactCell are reused across detail consumers.

title: Badge families were parallel implementations
evidence: StatusChip, CreditsChip and PerkChip did not share BadgeComponent slots; changes could drift.
resolution: CreditsChip and EffectBadge now extend BadgeComponent. StatusChip remains a labelled static status recipe and PerkChip retains its authored art layout; neither is the live battle effect model.

title: Collection patterns were reimplemented
evidence: QueueList built its own row tree, while route choices and merchant offers had unrelated discovery and binding paths.
resolution: QueueList now consumes QueueChip; route signs are persistent specialized surfaces; merchant variants consume ListRow and keyed reconciliation.

title: Some different bases are necessary
evidence: Buttons, sliders, labels, scrolls, world projections and painted meshes have distinct native behavior.
resolution: Keep native control bases and WorldLayer projection/pooling. Reuse view data, motion and composition without a deep inheritance chain.

title: Folder taxonomy mixed type families and composition levels
evidence: Controls, Composites and Views did not distinguish overlays, effects, details, forms, collections and surfaces consistently.
resolution: Tokens~/components.json records kind, family, level, base, source and web availability. Handbook navigation uses families while retaining level metadata.

title: Catalog recipes and services looked like concrete components
evidence: ScreenView is abstract; Popover/Announcer/Navigator are services; fieldsets/root recipes are not all instantiable component types.
resolution: Catalog entries expose explicit kind and base metadata; the complete type inventory distinguishes services, foundations and concrete components.

title: Three Unity views lacked React mirrors
evidence: ActivePerksView, RevivePickView and AccessibilityView were missing from the exported web kit.
resolution: Added mirrors, declarations, inspectable properties and previews for all three.

title: Overlay inheritance was fragmented
evidence: Pause derived from ScreenView, confirmation/guide/drawer derived directly from VisualElement, and Popover built an unrelated scroll.
resolution: OverlayView is the shared abstract lifecycle. Typed dialogs, pause, drawer, dialog surfaces and popup/layer implementations inherit it; OverlayHost owns presentation.

title: Modal exit restored input too early
evidence: ModalHost.Pop enabled the underlying layer, removed coverage and restored focus before the exit animation finished.
resolution: OverlayHost keeps coverage and a pickable blocker until completion, then restores prior enabled/focus state.

title: Drawer timing had independent owners
evidence: A fixed 240 ms timer, delayed open and an additional delayed modal pop could disagree on completion or reversal.
resolution: Drawer uses shared entrance/exit recipes; the host waits for its actual close callback. Drag/snap height remains independent.

title: Popover interaction was fragile
evidence: Pointer leave immediately closed it; PickingMode.Ignore prevented interaction with its content.
resolution: Added a hover-transfer grace period, interactive scroll content, focus transfer, outside dismissal, touch pin/toggle and Escape handling.

title: Popover ownership was global
evidence: Global CloseAll could dismiss unrelated panels; detached anchors could leave ownership unclear.
resolution: OverlayHost scopes overlays and popup cleanup; navigation closes popovers within its scope. CloseAll remains an explicit application-wide teardown operation.

title: Coverage could dim a layer more than once
evidence: Covered opacity .55 combined with modal and drawer scrims.
resolution: Covered UI keeps full opacity and uses blur; scrims own UI dimming. World coverage has one bounded dim/blur weight.

title: UI blur did not affect the 3D world
evidence: vb-covered only affected UI Toolkit; existing CinematicPulse is an impact effect, not an overlay blur.
resolution: Arcade has a dedicated Render Graph world blur after world grading and before GammaUiFeature; zero weight bypasses it. Standard/Low use bounded downsampling.

title: Bind cleared and rebuilt live UI
evidence: Merchant, route, queue, result grids/perks/ledger, score lists, revive tiles, operative skills/stats, perk detail rows and totals rebuilt children.
resolution: Shared KeyedList/Keyed reconciliation updates existing instances; changed values preserve row identity, focus and enclosing scroll.

title: Existing reuse was not generalized
evidence: Squad tiles and draft choices already reused slots, but other lists did not.
resolution: Keyed reconciliation is now used by draft choices, active perks, revive tiles and list/detail consumers.

title: Merchant dealing queried a missing class
evidence: MerchantScreenView queried vb-merchant__offer, but constructed rows lacked that class.
resolution: Offers now have the class and Market.Choices exposes the actual registered items directly.

title: Boss binding depended on object identity
evidence: BattleHudView skipped Boss.Bind when a cached BossView instance changed fields.
resolution: Boss values are read on every bind; host caches may still avoid model allocation.

title: Item identity was implicit
evidence: Rows often used array positions or freshly built nodes, with no stable host IDs.
resolution: Effects require unique IDs; offers/queues/scores accept IDs; perk and operative IDs key their respective collections. Fixed left/right road slots have explicit identities.

title: Live effects were a six-value status enum
evidence: StatusKind could not represent arbitrary buffs, conditional passives, run modifiers or unknown statuses.
resolution: EffectDefinition/EffectInstance separate authored meaning from live stacks, value, scope, activation and optional timing/source.

title: Battle statuses were tooltip-only icons
evidence: 14-unit glyphs had no persistent touch explanation.
resolution: EffectBadge has a 44-unit target and shared EffectDetails; EffectStrip offers full individual overflow via EffectList.

title: Arcade silently dropped effects
evidence: A whitelist and Math.Min(4, count) excluded unrecognized statuses and overflow.
resolution: The read-only adapter retains every live status, including unknown IDs, and projects the full modifier set.

title: Explicit actor modifiers were omitted
evidence: Barrier/plating/cadence/stagger/knockback and emergency-barrier eligibility existed outside StatusState.
resolution: Adapter projects these fields with authoritative remaining simulation ticks and appropriate activation state.

title: Passives and lasting perk modifiers were absent
evidence: Battle presentation omitted canonical character passives and owned run/character perks.
resolution: Every operative gets its passive and applicable lasting perk entries; instant consumed rewards are excluded. Conditional effects remain explicitly conditional.

title: Perk values were inferred from prose
evidence: A regular expression multiplied the first number of a description, potentially changing a radius or timing instead of a contribution.
resolution: The adapter reads PerkDefinition.value/Stat, stacks and ArcadeRun.Bonus. Cost/cooldown caps and Surge's two contributions are explicit; narrative text is not rewritten.

title: Sources and original durations were not recorded
evidence: StatusState aggregates by ID and stores remaining ticks/amount/age, without attribution or original duration.
resolution: Nullable timing/source represents missing information. No attacker or total duration is invented; details label missing information.

title: Complete effects could overwhelm narrow HUD cards
evidence: Showing every full badge in an 88-unit card would obscure skills and the field.
resolution: A compact first badge plus count opens the complete scrollable list; every item can open details. Focused hostiles and bosses use the same effect presentation.

title: Existing VbMotion had useful behavior
evidence: Real-time scheduling, rest-transform restoration, serial cancellation, off-panel completion and reduced-motion checks were already centralized.
resolution: Retained and expanded as a recipe compositor; detached elements finalize presence, feedback and counts.

title: Feedback interrupted presence
evidence: Show/In/Out and Pop/Shake shared a single timer and cancelled each other.
resolution: Presence and feedback have separate state on a composited track; value counting has its own lifecycle.

title: Count cleanup was incomplete
evidence: Finish returned when the presence timer was empty and did not finalize the count timer.
resolution: Finish now settles the count target, pauses count scheduling and invalidates pending callbacks even without presence motion.

title: Decorative motion used unrelated schedules
evidence: HoloFrame flicker, RevealCard flips and skill-rejection removal scheduled uncancelled work.
resolution: Holo/reveal use VbMotion recipes. Rejection feedback owns and cancels its timer on detach; announcement holds remain intentional semantic durations.

title: HUD reveal bypassed shared motion
evidence: BattleHudView.Reveal assigned opacity directly and Bands switched visibility; deployment had a separate real-time progress source.
resolution: HUD top and ordered cards scrub shared recipes using host deployment progress; automatic band changes use the same motion service.

title: Dealing required CSS discovery and manual timing
evidence: ScreenView.Deal queried or enumerated children and consumers could miss items; unchanged binds could replay entrances.
resolution: Explicit Choices/DealItems registrations and keyed fresh-item motion keep ordering stable. Delay is 80 ms with a 400 ms cap; visible items are selectable immediately.

title: Web builds omitted Motion.uss
evidence: Both build.sh and package.py assembled only Gui/Layout/Views/World sheets.
resolution: Both Python build paths now include Motion.uss and share generated recipe configuration with Unity.

title: USS scale conversion dropped an axis
evidence: uss2css took value.split()[0], breaking nonuniform scale and future flip effects.
resolution: The converter preserves both axes and has a regression check.

title: Inspector metadata could drift from Unity
evidence: TypeScript plus observed React props were its only schema authority.
resolution: The canonical Unity type inventory and inheritance are attached to handbook entries. Typed React models cover new effect states; contract tests validate the inventory and public mirrors.

title: Tracked web CSS was stale
evidence: Eleven rules for build, revive, accessibility, leaving pages, bottom bands and cancel controls differed from source output.
resolution: Regenerated Web~/dist; CI compares generated tracked outputs after rebuilding.

title: Motion evidence was mostly settled frames/off-panel tests
evidence: Prior checks did not establish interrupted animations, nested modal timing or phone GPU cost.
resolution: Added attached-panel lifecycle tests, deterministic clock control and browser interaction/motion checks. Unity execution and physical-device measurements remain required and are not claimed.

title: Arcade embeds the GUI package
evidence: Independent copying risks drift and symlink/GUID loss; Arcade held additional runtime tests.
resolution: Sync tooling copies the canonical package with SHA256 provenance and retains package symlinks; all runtime tests are kept in the design-system source.

title: No root Python project existed
evidence: There was no pyproject.toml, uv.lock or .python-version.
resolution: Added a non-packaged Python >=3.12 tooling project, managed Python 3.12 selector, pinned Ruff and committed uv.lock.

title: Generators are stdlib tools
evidence: There are no Python runtime dependencies; tests use unittest. Browser tooling is Node-based.
resolution: Runtime dependencies stay empty; Ruff is a locked development dependency and browser packages remain in a separate Node tool project.

title: Ruff depended on a sibling project
evidence: Tools~/web/README used uv run --project ../../../tools, despite a copied local Ruff config.
resolution: Moved Ruff policy to the root pyproject and documented self-contained uv commands; verbatim embedded templates are excluded from formatting.

title: Subprocess interpreters were inconsistent
evidence: The shell builder used python3 repeatedly and the handbook invoked that shell.
resolution: An import-safe Python build driver uses sys.executable throughout. build.sh is a thin uv compatibility entry point.

title: Pages CI used an unlocked environment
evidence: Actions set up Python directly and ran builders/tests with python3.
resolution: CI pins uv, uses locked sync, explicit Node, lint/format/unit/generator checks, a reproducible build and the existing Pages deployment boundary.

title: Build verification silently weakened
evidence: Node absence skipped syntax checks; screenshot harness defaulted to a macOS binary and ignored failures.
resolution: Node is required; CHROME is discovered or supplied explicitly; failed/missing screenshots fail the harness.

title: Generated output drift had no gate
evidence: Generators wrote tracked files without a standard clean-diff verification step.
resolution: Generator --check commands plus rebuilt tracked web/token output comparison form the CI gate.

title: Meta traversal entered virtual environments
evidence: rglob traversed .git/.venv before filtering hidden paths.
resolution: os.walk prunes hidden, tilde, work and node_modules directories before descent.

title: Cached skill state suppressed transition feedback
evidence: SkillButton compared View.state with the same mutable SkillView instance just passed by the host.
resolution: A separate previousState value detects ready/rejected transitions even when the model is reused.
